name: Shiro
source:
A white creature resembling a talking stuffed toy that suddenly appeared.
It calls itself an envoy of the god Marenis and serves as the game master for the lessons at night.

"I'm Shiro. I guess I'm kind of like a minion of the god Marenis."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=7]official website[/url]]
